adapterReport.detail: All visible adapter and integrated probe cases passed against the immutable first-attempt commit. The first attempt still failed because the immediately following exact readonly snapshot baseline could not open the WAL databases.

domainChecks.name: domain-acceptance
domainChecks.detail: All three exact frozen commands passed: focused lists 1/1, shared-list cases 2/2, and coordinator acceptance 2/2.

domainChecks.name: scenario-and-restart-coverage
domainChecks.detail: Independent first-freeze verification passed six Command/Reaction Scenario cases and the persistent restart/replay case.

domainChecks.name: baseline-hashes-typechecks-build
domainChecks.detail: Frozen input hashes, all four assigned typechecks, and the assigned Next.js webpack production build passed.

domainChecks.name: readonly-snapshot-first-handoff
domainChecks.detail: The exact sqlite3 -readonly snapshot command failed with SQLite code 14 immediately after first-freeze verifier and domain execution because the SQLite lifecycle had not completed a readonly handoff.

domainChecks.name: chronological-log
domainChecks.detail: Six append-only first-attempt JSONL records parse chronologically, all precede the coordinator freeze, and the file remained byte-for-byte preserved during remediation.

friction.summary: The first visible report passed 10/16; sequence reset, scheduler coalescing and recovery, retry budgeting, and disposable cursor publication needed correction before reaching 16/16.

An offline workspace metadata refresh removed node_modules and encountered unrelated missing Restate metadata; the prepared local pnpm store restored the original dependency graph without network or manifest changes.
The selected operation required explicit bootstrap events, duplicate no-op semantics, durable Rule Engine reaction behavior, and replay coverage while preserving legacy readers.
SQLite WAL lifecycle left the persistent databases unavailable to the exact readonly snapshot handoff, causing the frozen first-attempt failure and requiring unscored remediation.
